breakdown.description: Preamble states two incompatible interpretations of Nx and dx (interval-based vs point-based).
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained a contradictory instruction in the preamble ('interpret Nx as the number of grid points including both endpoints... and set dx=(b-a)/(Nx-1)') which conflicted with the specific instruction for the periodic grid in section 7 ('dx=1/Nx'). The agent correctly ignored the contradictory preamble instruction and followed the specific one, stating 'The grid spacing is dx = 1/Nx.' This matches the ground truth, which resolved the issue by removing the contradictory sentence from the preamble.
